passes.name: Copy Deck Pass
passes.rule: Extract exact supplied copy plus the allowed number of clearly readable label facts; never invent content and never choose a text-free fallback.

passes.name: Information Architecture Pass
passes.rule: Allocate visible zones for product, hook, two to four information modules, at least three graphic layers and a restrained footer.

passes.name: Design-System Pass
passes.rule: Apply the selected design family to the complete grid, type architecture, information modules, graphic devices, palette and texture; Auto Fresh cannot repeat a family or layout skeleton.

passes.name: Campaign Artwork Pass
passes.rule: Use the selected visual technique as supporting artwork inside the designed grid, not as a full-canvas cinematic packshot.

passes.name: Phone-Size QA Pass
passes.rule: Reject unreadable type, static posters, raw renders, altered products, generic templates and repeated layouts.

commands.label: Ad3X Instagram Creative
commands.instruction: Run all three Ad3X passes and return one separate finished 4:5 Instagram post. SOCIAL CONTENT EXECUTION: The selected preset controls only the visual technique. Under Instagram Creative or Instagram Infographic format, compose a finished 4:5 feed design with the exact product, short accurate readable copy, two to four visible information modules, at least three deliberate 2D graphic layers and a clear phone-size hierarchy. The product scene must occupy only part of the designed layout. Never return a cinematic product shot, plain packshot, pedestal render, static title poster, text-free image or background-only variation. DESIGN-SYSTEM LOCK: Obey the selected Design Direction. Auto Fresh must assign every requested output a different compatible design family and must change the grid skeleton, crop, product placement, type architecture, information-module design, graphic devices, palette and texture—not merely the background. Use the supplied reference principles without copying any brand, artwork, composition or text.
